da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: descent-lemma.md states three things about `𝔡ₙ : End_C(Aₙ) → End_C(A_{n-1})`: it is a surjective ALGEBRA homomorphism, it INTERTWINES the `G_q`-actions, and `(C, A_{n-1}, τ)` is again a QOU. The Lean encodes only the first, and until this commit encoded it as `→ₗ[R]` (a LinearMap — multiplicativity dropped entirely); descent-lemma.lean:82 now uses `→ₐ[R]`. The `G_q`-intertwining and the QOU-preservation claim have no counterpart in the Lean at all. The prior sidecar entry recorded `pass` on the weaker version.
